name: Hearthside
tagline: A warm, distraction-free journal with Kesiel, a companion who reflects on what you write.
description: Hearthside is a cozy, distraction-free journal. Write with rich formatting and photos, tag your mood, and watch your habit grow on a calendar and gentle charts. After each entry, Kesiel — your companion — reads it and offers a short, warm reflection and a question to carry into tomorrow. Ask Kesiel to find anything you've written ("when did I mention the beach?") or sum up your week. Includes a daily writing reminder, a focus mode, light and dark themes, an optional privacy lock, and backups you can take anywhere. Your journal is saved to your Anna account; Kesiel thinks with Anna's built-in AI, and only reads your pages when you save an entry or ask him something.
changelog: Kesiel can now find your photos: each photo you add gets a short description, so you can ask him about your pictures (switch it off in Settings → Kesiel). "Write about it" now opens a fresh page with the prompt at the top, and the prompt card moves on to a new one.
